title: Product Execution Readiness
description: Experimental (`media_buy.execution_readiness`). Whether the caller's account can satisfy a product's `execution_requirements[]`, one entry per requirement plus a rollup. Account-scoped; carried only in the response-level `execution_readiness` map of `get_products`. Annotate, never filter: a product whose status is not `ready`, including `unknown`, is still a product the buyer may be able to run.

status.description: Rollup of `requirements[].status`, derivable from it: the first of `setup_required`, `input_required`, `selection_required`, `unknown` that any requirement reports, else `ready`. The rollup is the most blocking state the seller could establish, so `unknown` is reported only when no requirement is definitely blocking and at least one could not be checked. Buyers needing detail MUST read `requirements[]`.

requirements.description: Readiness of each entry in the product's `execution_requirements[]`, in any order. Every declared entry MUST appear once; a seller that did not evaluate one reports it `unknown` with `unknown_reason: not_evaluated`.
